newsitem.title: UK: GDR REPORT-India eases after local market dive.
newsitem.headline: GDR REPORT-India eases after local market dive.

text.p: Indian global depositary receipts were easier on Friday after stocks in India slid on the back of a disappointing package of economic reforms announced late on Thursday.
But traders saw relatively good volumes on the day and said losses had been limited as the GDR market discounted much of Bombay's fall on Thursday, following the late announcement of the package.
"We saw some good two-way business. There was some selling first thing but most of the losses had been anticipated," a trader said.
Good volumes were seen in a number of stocks, including Bajaj, BSES, Grasim and SBI.
"There was tremendous disappointment (about the package). It was amazing that the government could have mismanaged its PR (public relations) so massively," the trader said.

On Thursday, Finance Minister P. Chidambaram announced the decision to allow foreign portfolio investment in debt and government gilts, among other measures, some of which had been announced through January.
He said these amounted to a package of economic reforms.
Also, the Securities and Exchange Board of India said late on Thursday it had approved a new takeover code for companies and a stock lending scheme.
The market had expected a more comprehensive package of new measures.
A trader said it was unlikely that the market would extend declines significantly next week, with GDR trade seen limited in the short term.
The HSBC James Capel Indian GDR index JCEAI was down 1.65 points at 64.14, with the premium over the local market at 9.14 percent from 7.86 percent on Thursday.
The Bombay Stock Exchange 30-share index closed 127.58 points lower at 3,382.47.
The Capel Korea GDR Index added 0.20 points to 66.96, a premium of 52.86 percent over the local market after the Korea Composite index rose 9.32 points to 685.84.
The Capel Taiwan GDR Index ended 1.26 points up at 101.74, a premium of 5.56 percent after the Taiwan Weighted Index made 61.42 points to 7,283.40.
